invariants: Every API route has a reviewed public, authenticated-free, paid, or conditional-paid classification.
Paid routes retain a declarative entitlement dependency and an authenticated session dependency.
PIN, session, local-origin, step-up, and feature failures fail closed.
Reset and restore require verified recovery material and preserve rollback evidence.
Backup names cannot collide and retention never removes the active recovery point.
Money inputs are finite, range-bounded, and normalized with explicit decimal rounding.
Transfers, refunds, reversals, income, spending, goals, FX, reports, and tax packs share verified semantics.
Sparse or incomplete evidence is disclosed instead of converted into authoritative advice.
Duplicate source identities and retries cannot create duplicate financial effects.
Concurrent writes are guarded by database identities, rollback, or explicit conflict handling.
Gmail, LLM, FX, licensing, parser, and local-model failures expose stable safe errors with request correlation.
Provider text, secrets, paths, and raw financial narration do not cross public error or hosted-AI boundaries.
Unsupported or ambiguous statements are rejected.
Direction, row identity, source provenance, control totals, preview fingerprints, and finalized-period checks survive import.
The real lifespan initializes encryption, migration, seeds, auth state, optional AI, scheduler, readiness, and shutdown in order.
The ordered migration registry is contiguous, restart-safe, backed up, validated, and schema-compatible with model metadata.
Critical desktop and website journeys support keyboard input, narrow viewports, and reduced motion.
Release browser and packaged-platform matrices are tracked separately and cannot be inferred from unit-test count.
